title: Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane)
summary: Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane) is a university in New Orleans. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Tulane.

sections.heading: What Tulane is known for
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane) is a private nonprofit institution known for its selective admissions and diverse academic programs. With an undergraduate enrollment of 7,767 students, Tulane maintains an admission rate of approximately 14 percent, reflecting its competitive nature. The university offers a variety of programs, with a significant portion of students enrolled in business-related fields, accounting for about 30 percent of the undergraduate population. Additionally, health-related programs represent roughly 7 percent of the student body. Tulane's reputation is shaped by its commitment to providing a comprehensive education within a private nonprofit framework.

sections.heading: How to read Tulane tuition
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane) charges the same tuition rate for both in-state and out-of-state students, which is $68,678. This uniform tuition policy means that residency status does not affect the tuition cost. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as fees, room, board, and other related costs, amounts to $87,004. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and their families plan for the financial commitment required to attend Tulane.
